title: JustGlasses+
body:
This resource pack modifies glass panes using CustomModelData.

Here is the list of CustomModelData values:
- red_stained_glass_pane: `background.number`
- lime_stained_glass_pane: `background.location`
- cyan_stained_glass_pane: `background.vector`
- purple_stained_glass_pane: `background.sound`
- pink_stained_glass_pane: `background.particle`
- magenta_stained_glass_pane: `background.potion`
- green_stained_glass_pane: `background.variable`
- yellow_stained_glass_pane: `background.array`
- brown_stained_glass_pane: `background.map`
- blue_stained_glass_pane: `background.parameter`
- orange_stained_glass_pane: `background.item`, `background.block`
